design_philosophy: Voxel-inspired neo-brutalism. Deep earthy tones combined with high-contrast gaming elements. Emphasizes blocky aesthetics, hard shadows, and immersive 3D generated backgrounds. Avoids standard SaaS styling in favor of community-focused, playful yet robust gaming interfaces.

typography.instructions: Use VT323 for high-impact headers. IBM Plex Sans for legible reading of guides/mods. Headings must never use generic sans. Silkscreen used for small badges, tags, and overlines.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid) for visual tension. Use asymmetrical spans (col-span-8, col-span-4) for features.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm (Embrace the blocky Minecraft aesthetic)

surfaces_and_effects.cards: Neo-brutalist block styling: dark background (#1C1C1E), 1px sharp inner border (border-white/10), and a hard blocky drop shadow (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#000] or shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#22C55E] on hover).
surfaces_and_effects.glassmorphism: Used only for the sticky navigation. backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 border-b border-white/10.
surfaces_and_effects.buttons: Blocky, sharp corners. Primary CTA uses emerald green bg, black text, hard black shadow. Hover pushes button down: translate-x-[2px] translate-y-[2px] and reduces shadow to 2px.
surfaces_and_effects.hover_states: Interactive elements must translate up and left (-translate-y-1 -translate-x-1) and increase hard shadow offset, maintaining the 'block' interaction feel.

media.instructions: Hero background must use a dark overlay (bg-black/50 to bg-black/70) to ensure the logo and IP copy text are legible. Use background images extensively in bento cards with blend modes.

component_instructions.navigation: Sticky top, glassmorphism. Left: Logo. Center: Nav links. Right: Discord icon + 'Management Panel' link. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide.
component_instructions.hero: Center aligned. Massive logo image. Subtitle. 'Copy IP' widget (a stylized input field with a copy button). 'Join Discord' secondary CTA. Live player count badge floating near IP widget.
component_instructions.ip_copy_widget: A dark blocky input displaying 'play.ourcraft.net' (mock IP) with a bright green 'Copy' button. On click, show a toast 'IP Copied to Clipboard!'.
component_instructions.live_status: Integrate a section with visual indicators (green pulsing dot) showing 'Server Online' and mock stats (e.g., 24/100 players, 45 in Discord).
component_instructions.features_bento: Asymmetrical grid. Use features_background and mods_background inside specific cards with overlay text. Highlight 'Modded Terrain', 'Custom Structures', 'SMP Community'.
component_instructions.how_to_play: Step-by-step vertical timeline or horizontal cards. 1. Java 2. Fabric/Forge 3. Modpack 4. Connect. Use block icons for each step.
component_instructions.mods_list: Cardless or dense list. Clean typography (IBM Plex). Title, short description, usage tip. Maybe accordion style using Shadcn.
component_instructions.gallery: Grid layout. Mix generated images and placeholders. Include hover zoom effect.
component_instructions.discord_widget: A dark window styling representing an in-game chat feed bridged to Discord. Use semantic tags and mock chat lines. CTA 'Join Discord' to https://discord.gg/pFj6mZubVu
component_instructions.management_redirect: Prominent 'Management Panel' CTA in header and footer linking to https://management_panel.mcboost.online/

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text on #1C1C1E passes APCA. Use text-shadow on hero text.
accessibility_and_testing.motion: Use smooth scrolling (Lenis) if possible. Ensure hover translations do not trigger layout shifts.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements (e.g., 'copy-ip-button', 'nav-management-link', 'discord-invite-button').

tech_stack.framework: React JS, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
